beats.title: Fleshborn and portals: the Dustwalker's spell erupts
beats.summary: Fleshborn tentacles grapple through the holes, catching Lysandra, Baergrom, a goblin child, and Bonogo, though Karsemine escapes. The Dustwalker completes his spell, opening vertical rips in space near Karsemine, Baergrom, Caelynn, and Stafl; tentacles grab Karsemine and Caelynn fully while Stafl and Baergrom dodge. The Dustwalker kicks a goblin child and escapes with Misty Step. Lysandra attacks and inspires Baergrom; fire spreads; Karsemine breaks free of tentacles taking psychic damage; Stafl hits the Dustwalker with Hideous Laughter but the portals remain.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-7:3944b26180b9:span:3944b26180b9:16-16
anchor_quotes: The Fleshborn inside attacks with its tentacles right through the hole
uses Dark Whisper on Bonogo
is able to grapple Lysandra and Baergrom, Karsemine escapes
The Dustwalker finally finishes his spell, opening vertical rips in space near Karsemine, Baergrom, Caelynn and Stafl.
Karsemine and Caelynn are completely wrapped up, including their face and head.
makes a run for it with Misty Step
Stafl is able to chase down the Dustwalker and hits him with Hideous Laughter, hoping to incapacitate and break the spells for the portals. The portals remain up.
Bonogo sneak attacks the tentacles holding Caelynn, but couldn’t free her

beats.title: Portal destruction and Devour the Weak
beats.summary: Ephanna's Fey kills a Cultist and Ephanna finishes a monster with Eldritch Blast. Baergrom uses Bait and Switch, Commander's Strike with Karsemine, Horde Breaker, and cleave. Caelynn destroys the portal holding her with Magic Missile. A monster uses Devour the Weak on Lysandra for necrotic damage; the priest casts Dark Wispers on Bonogo; the monster holding Bonogo also Devours him. Portals grapple Baergrom and a goblin child; the Dustwalker fails poison and laughter saves; monsters crit Karsemine; a goblin child is pulled into a portal and absorbed; Karsemine destroys the portal holding Baergrom.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-7:3944b26180b9:span:3944b26180b9:18-18
anchor_quotes: Ephanna’s Fey attacks and kills one of the Cultists
Baergrom uses Bait and Switch then Commander’s Strike with Karsemine
Caelynn uses Magic Missile on the portal holding her, and destroys it.
A monster grappling Lysandra uses Devour the Weak
The priest moves outside closer to Bonogo then casts Dark Wispers on him, dealing psychic damage.
One of the goblin children is pulled into the portal and absorbed.
She attacks, uses Horde Breaker, attacks again then uses Nick and destroys it, freeing Baergrom.

beats.title: Escalation: Bonogo near unconscious, Caelynn down, fire spreads
beats.summary: Stafl fires his crossbow at the portal and moves to the Dustwalker; Bonogo still cannot escape the monster grappling him. Ephanna's first Eldritch Blast accidentally knocks Caelynn unconscious while the second hits the priest; Ephanna's fey lands a killing blow. Baergrom attacks multiple monsters with his greataxe; Caelynn makes her first death saving throw. The priest and a monster attack Bonogo, bringing him near unconsciousness; another monster damages Baergrom while missing Lysandra. The Dustwalker remains poisoned and prone from Hideous Laughter, Lysandra misses, and the fire spreads alarmingly.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-7:3944b26180b9:span:3944b26180b9:20-20
anchor_quotes: Stafl fires a shot from his crossbow at the portal then moves to the Dustwalker.
Bonogo attacks the monster grappling him, attempting to escape, but cannot.
The first blast misses the target and instead knocks Caelynn unconscious.
Caelynn makes her first death saving throw.
The priest and the monster both attack Bonogo, who is now very close to being knocked unconscious as well.
The Dustwalker is still poisoned and prone due to hideous laughter.
Finally, the fire begins to spread up and out, now at an alarming pace.
